title: No linear correlations with target
summary: All Pearson and Spearman correlations between numeric features and performance_rating are below |r|=0.10 (max |r|=0.0860). Hypothesis H-CORR-NONE is not rejected.

title: No non-linear relationships detected
summary: Mutual information scores for all features fall outside the 95th percentile of the shuffled null baseline. Hypothesis H-NONLIN-NONE is rejected (check features).

title: No salary band effect on performance
summary: One-way ANOVA shows F=0.72, p=0.5794, η²=0.0036. Hypothesis H-SALARY-NODIFF is not rejected.

title: No multicollinearity among predictors
summary: All VIF values are near 1.0 (max VIF=1.01), confirming features are independently generated.

title: Random Forest model shows no predictive signal
summary: 5-fold CV R²=-0.0980 (≤0.02 threshold). Model RMSE (10.43) matches dummy baseline (9.99). H-MODEL-NOSIGNAL is not rejected.

title: Dataset confirmed as pure noise
summary: Permutation test (200 shuffles) yields empirical p=0.510. Actual R² (-0.0980) is indistinguishable from null distribution (mean=-0.0956). H-NOISE is not rejected (data is noise).
